subject: ARLO SEO — Weekly Pulse — 2026-10-02
html:
Weekly Pulse — Oct 2, 2026

~13 weeks since kickoff (2026-07-04). Fresh live pull, site_id 12704162.

Leads proxy (GA4 conversions)

Pending. GA4 (G-CP22NBPLFP) is firing on the live site, but this sandbox has no outbound access to the GA4 reporting API, so conversions can't be pulled from here. A scheduled data Action (outside this sandbox) fills this number in later — until then, leading indicators below (rank, backlinks, AI visibility) are the only available signal.

All 22 tracked keywords sat at the not-ranked floor (avg position 100) every single day this week (9/25→10/2), Google USA — unchanged since tracking began 2026-08-01, now 13 straight weeks flat. Domain Trust holds at 6 (3rd straight monthly increment, pre-GSC-submission); index_google still reads \"1\".

Traffic vs last week

SE Ranking's domain overview still returns no ranking keywords for askarlo.app in the US index — no organic footprint to measure traffic from yet, unchanged from last week.

Anything broken?

No. Last 6 SEO Report Email runs (09-28 through 10-01) all green, 46/46 all-time, zero failures. Backlinks flat at 3 / 2 referring domains, unchanged since 2026-09-10 (4th week flat). AI Result Tracker still has zero LLM engines configured — no AI-visibility baseline exists; this needs a human decision in SE Ranking before AI-citation movement can be tracked at all (a PROJECT_createLlmEngine tool exists in this sandbox's toolset, but spending on the account's SE Ranking subscription isn't this routine's call to make). catalog.ts's 9 gated connectors (meta_ads/linkedin_ads/meta_pages, shopify, tiktok_ads/stripe, hubspot/mailerlite, mailchimp — all past their own ETAs) and the destinations catalog (Excel/Snowflake/Redshift/Databricks/Notion/Airtable all still coming_soon/waitlist) are both byte-for-byte unchanged from last week — no new content lever opened.

Reading the week

A quiet week by design: yesterday's session (10/1) closed out the last open static audit (sxo.md, now fully re-verified against current code) on top of the quarterly and Month-3 reviews, so there was no new content gap to re-check today — just the pulse itself, and every number came back identical to last week's. The underlying keyword thesis keeps holding (claude mcp server, mcp connector, google analytics mcp all flat-to-up in volume, all already targeted by live pages), so 13 straight weeks at the not-ranked floor reads as a brand-new domain (DA 0) still inside Google's normal indexing/trust ramp, not a content problem. The two things actually worth a human's 30 minutes this week, unchanged from every recent pulse: (1) GSC sitemap submission, still not done since Week 1 of the original plan; (2) off-page Phase 1, still 0 of 6 free directory listings. Both are the cheapest, most leveraged open items on the entire plan and both are blocked only on a human clicking a few buttons — no amount of further on-page work from this routine substitutes for either moving.
